subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The park began restoring part of the grassland.”?
options: Many people thought the old bridge would be removed.
People sell flowers, small trees, herbs, and vegetable plants.
Some visitors were confused when trees were removed.
Students also planted three young trees nearby.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Many people thought the old bridge would be removed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People sell flowers, small trees, herbs, and vegetable plants.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The park began restoring part of the grassland. Some visitors were confused when trees were removed.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students also planted three young trees nearby.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The park began restoring part of the grassland. Some visitors were confused when trees were removed.」，答案為「Some visitors were confused when trees were removed.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some visitors were confused when trees were removed.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
